## Transferable mechanism summary

MISSING GUARANTEE: lock-context discipline — a spinlock reachable from softirq/timer context must be acquired with spin_lock_bh()/local_bh_disable() at every process-context site; plain spin_lock() only disables preemption, not bottom halves, so a softirq can run on the same CPU between lock and unlock. UNSAFE USE: process call chain (worker -> driver helper -> hw_tx/enqueue) holds the plain-acquired lock, then a softirq on the same CPU spins forever trying to take that same lock while the holder can never resume — a self-deadlock. CONSEQUENCE: softirq/soft-lockup on one CPU, RCU stall and watchdog splats, device TX stall, repeatable denial of service. The invariant generalizes one level up: a lock shared with a hardirq handler needs irqsave/irq-disable at non-irq sites.
